correctness.rationale: Derivations of the chain incidence algebra are inner by an explicit idempotent construction; zero square removes diagonal differences. In odd characteristic the second commutator equals -2NXN after N²=0, and matrix-unit evaluation detects every forbidden pair of nonzero entries without cancellations. The support criterion, affine component structure and distinct-extrema count follow. Exhaustive direct compositions agree for 75,433 candidates across five test fields/sizes.
